blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ki khaas baat: chaaron angles \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke odd multiples (\(\frac{3\pi}{2}\), \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\)) ke saath hain, is liye har ratio apne co-ratio mein badlega.
Diya kya hai? Do products ka farq. Prove kya karna hai? Ke yeh \(-1\) hai.
Plan: chaaron ratios chhote karna, phir Pythagorean identity \(\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - \cot^2\theta = 1\) lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \sec\left(\frac{3\pi}{2} - \theta\right)\sec\left(\frac{5\pi}{2} - \theta\right) - \tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{2} - \theta\right)\tan\left(\frac{5\pi}{2} + \theta\right)\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= -1\).
Tareeqa: \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) (\(270^{\circ}\)) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\) (\(450^{\circ}\)) dono \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke odd multiples hain (3 aur 5 guna). Is liye sec badal kar cosec aur tan badal kar cot. \(\frac{5\pi}{2} = 2\pi + \frac{\pi}{2}\), yani ek chakkar aur \(\frac{\pi}{2}\); quadrant dekhte waqt chakkar hata dein.

Dono secants chhote karein
\[\sec\left(\tfrac{3\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = -\operatorname{cosec}\theta\]
\[\sec\left(\tfrac{5\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = \operatorname{cosec}\theta\]
Kyun: \(\frac{3\pi}{2} - \theta\) yani \(270^{\circ}\) se thora peeche, quadrant III, jahan cos aur sec negative hain. \(\frac{5\pi}{2} - \theta\) ek chakkar hata kar \(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\) hai, quadrant I, sab positive.

Dono tangents chhote karein
\[\tan\left(\tfrac{3\pi}{2} - \theta\right) = \cot\theta\]
\[\tan\left(\tfrac{5\pi}{2} + \theta\right) = -\cot\theta\]
Kyun: Quadrant III mein tan positive hai, is liye pehla plus. \(\frac{5\pi}{2} + \theta\) ek chakkar hata kar \(\frac{\pi}{2} + \theta\) hai, quadrant II, jahan tan negative hai, is liye doosra minus.

Values rakhein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = (-\operatorname{cosec}\theta)(\operatorname{cosec}\theta)\]
\[\quad - (\cot\theta)(-\cot\theta)\]
\[= -\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta + \cot^2\theta\]
Kyun: Pehla product \(-\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta\). Doosre product mein \(\cot\theta \times (-\cot\theta) = -\cot^2\theta\), aur us se pehle bhi minus hai, is liye \(+\cot^2\theta\).
Dhyan dein: beech wale minus ko bhool jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

Pythagorean identity lagayein
\[= -(\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - \cot^2\theta)\]
\[= -1 = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(1 + \cot^2\theta = \operatorname{cosec}^2\theta\) har angle ke liye sach hai (yeh \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\) ko \(\sin^2\theta\) se divide karne se milti hai). Is liye \(\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - \cot^2\theta = 1\), aur minus bahar nikalne se \(-1\).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: expression \(-1\) ke barabar hai.
